column1: # aux-registry v3 (v2 rows remain readable for migration)
# mainModId
# v3.6 invariant:
# - PATCH is no longer one global YES/NO flag.
# - Patch Discovery Graph discovers candidate families from same-page Files, Nexus reverse Requirements,
#   description links/text, learned independent patch pages, installed MO2 context, and local FOMOD evidence.
# - Every discovered family must be resolved for the exact target mainFileId before MAIN can download.
# kind = PATCH | TRANSLATION | SELF
# PATCH status = REQUIRED | NOT_APPLICABLE | ALREADY_INCLUDED | OBSOLETE | NONE
# TRANSLATION status = REQUIRED | NONE
# SELF status = AUX
# PATCH family examples: USSEP, LUX, LUX_ORBIS, JK_SKYRIM, LOTD, WACCF, CUSTOM:...
# REQUIRED:
#   Exact auxModId + auxFileId + auxVersion + auxName required; audit-registry.js verifies Nexus identity.
# NOT_APPLICABLE:
#   Candidate exists but the relevant counterpart mod is not active/present in this MO2 setup.
# ALREADY_INCLUDED:
#   Compatibility fix is incorporated in main/current package; evidence must say where this is stated.
# OBSOLETE:
#   Patch is superseded/deprecated for the target main file; evidence required.
# NONE:
#   Only useful when discovery itself found zero candidate families. Blanket PATCH=NONE cannot override discovered candidates.
# AUX:
#   kind=SELF only; marks an independent patch/translation page as an auxiliary transaction item.
# checkedAt + evidence are mandatory for decisions. Default freshness window is 14 days.
# mainFileId is the hard anchor: never reuse a conclusion merely because the version string is equal.
